meta.title: MeetNotes | AI meeting notes from audio and video
meta.description: Upload a meeting recording and get a transcript, speaker breakdown, summary, action items and decisions — processed in the background.

footer.madeWith: MeetNotes · AI meeting notes built with NestJS, React Router, Whisper and Claude.

hero.badge: Whisper + Claude, running in the background
hero.title: Turn every meeting recording into notes your team will actually read
hero.description: Drop in an audio or video file. MeetNotes transcribes it with Whisper, separates the speakers and asks Claude for a summary, action items and decisions — while you get on with your day.

highlights.auth: Long recordings processed as background jobs

features.title: Three background stages, one page of notes
features.description: Every stage is a separate queue job with retries, so a hiccup in summarisation never re-runs a 40-minute transcription.

upload.title: 1. Upload
upload.description: Drag an MP3, M4A, WAV or MP4 into the dashboard. The file lands in object storage and a job is queued immediately.

pipeline.title: 2. Transcribe & diarize
pipeline.description: Whisper produces timestamped segments; a diarization step labels who said what. Watch progress live on the meeting page.

aiNotes.title: 3. AI notes
aiNotes.description: Claude writes the summary, extracts action items with owners and due dates, and records the decisions — each linked back to the transcript.

pricing.title: Self-hosted, your recordings stay yours
pricing.description: Runs on Postgres, Redis and any S3-compatible bucket. Bring your own Whisper (API or local) and Anthropic key, or use the built-in mock adapters to try the flow without any credentials.
pricing.amountNote: license — pay only your model usage
pricing.additional: Swap adapters through environment variables: OpenAI Whisper, local whisper CLI, pyannote, Claude or heuristics.
